mentions.name: Creeper Eyes
mentions.description: An open-source firmware for a 3D printed animated Frankenstein head that upgrades it with a network management console, RESTful API, NTP time sync, animated clock hands on the pupils so the head doubles as a clock, night sleep mode, alternate eye styles, and OTA firmware updates.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I took this existing 3d printed animated Frankenstein head: https://www.printables.com/model/620191-frankenstein-head-with-animated-eyes

... and used Claude to crank the software up to 11. Network management console, RESTful API, added hands hands to the pupils so it serves as a clock, NTP, added sleep mode at night, added different eyes, OTA firmware updates, and more: https://github.com/michael-gebis/creeper-eyes
mentions.author: IvyMike
